evidence: Caes. BG 7.52: temeritātem cupiditātemque mīlitum reprehendit (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Off. 1.101: omnis āctiō vacāre dēbet temeritāte et neglegentiā (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: temeritās est vidēlicet flōrentis aetātis, prūdentia senēscentis
phrases.english: rashness, of course, belongs to youth in its bloom, good sense to age

sources: Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections, checked against the editions named there.
